title: External creditor losses have an unamplified asset-error bound
checked_scope: The pro-rata creditor-network clearing model and external-loss function, sharpening its asset-sensitivity conclusion and deriving convexity.
significance: A conservation-based 1-Lipschitz loss bound and convexity separate internal payment amplification from outside-creditor losses and sharpen common-parameter extrema.
